svg.text: My AI team: the tools and the workflow
A practical setup on my Mac — with explicit handoffs and durable project context.
1 WHERE I WORK AND CHECK IN
Profiles and boards at my desk
Local drafting, media briefs, idea capture
A coordinator model is separate from a coding worker.
Task status, owner, blocker and next action
Links to approved documents and evidence
One work record; separate project boards
Manual document handoff; auto sync unverified
Approve the scope and exact artifacts before dispatch or publication.
4 EXECUTION OPTIONS — HERMES AGENT DISPATCH IS PLANNED
Remote access works; task-to-worker binding is pending.
Optional local worker via LM Studio
Git branch → frozen commit → separate verification → my merge / release decision
5 CONTENT DESTINATIONS — AUTOMATED PUBLISHING IS PLANNED
Video / short-video production tools: still to choose and connect.
The Medium draft is edited manually; no department publishes automatically.
Solid: current tool or configured service
Tool availability does not mean every connection or workflow has passed an end-to-end test.
Logos / app icons belong to their respective owners. No endorsement is implied.
Setup snapshot: October 2026 · Obsidian is durable context, not automatic model memory.
